WHY UVWEAR?

A little colour change. A big reminder.

UVWEAR is a swimwear brand built around one simple idea: make sun awareness easier to see. Our UV-responsive swimwear is designed to shift from blue to purple as UV exposure changes, giving you a visible prompt to check your sun protection and remember to reapply sunscreen when needed.

Our goal is to encourage safer habits in the sun. UVWEAR does not prevent skin cancer, but we hope our clothing can help people stay more aware of UV exposure and take sun protection seriously while enjoying the outdoors.

Our inspiration: Australian-born actor Hugh Jackman has spoken publicly about his experiences with skin cancer and repeated treatment. His story is a reminder that skin cancer can affect anyone, and inspired UVWEAR to make sun safety part of what you wear.
HOW IT WORKS

Blue to purple. Check your sun protection.

A simple visual cue to help keep sun safety on your radar.

01

Start in blue

Your UVWEAR piece begins in its vibrant blue colour.

02

UV exposure changes

As UV exposure increases, the responsive fabric is designed to shift towards purple.

03

Check and reapply

When you notice the purple shift, use it as a reminder to check your sun protection and reapply sunscreen as directed.

Important: the colour change is not a sunscreen timer and cannot tell you whether sunscreen has worn off. UV levels, shade, clothing and sunscreen use all matter. Always follow sunscreen label instructions and seek shade, wear protective clothing, a broad-brim hat and sunglasses.
